profile_text.body:
Luma AI is a creative AI platform founded in 2021 and headquartered in Redwood City, California, focused on video generation and image creation. The company describes itself as powered by two video generation models, Ray and Uni, alongside creative agents designed to handle end-to-end workflows. It describes its platform as trusted by leading agencies and brands.

The company's flagship AI products include Ray, a video generation model, and Uni-1, which the site describes as brand intelligence at the model level, capable of understanding a brand's style references, character references, and visual grounding to carry them into generated assets. Luma AI is tracked on this site under the Video Generation and Editing category. The site also notes a collaboration between Wonder Project and Luma to launch a production services company combining generative AI and traditional filmmaking.

The held facts indicate Luma AI has a notable legal exposure footprint, with 181 cases recorded in California. No MCP server presence or SEC filings are noted in the available data.
